step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Veritas InfoScale enabling data migration, storage tiering, and disaster recovery across on-premises, AWS Region 1, and AWS Region 2. First, on-premises business-critical application data (BCS) is replicated via InfoScale's global file system into AWS Region 1. In Region 1, InfoScale manages compute (EC2) and tiers storage dynamically between EBS volumes (for high performance/standard HDD data) and S3 buckets (for archived/cold data). Second, for disaster recovery and cross-region availability, InfoScale replicates application state and data asynchronously/synchronously to Region 2, writing to EC2, EBS, and S3 in Region 2. AWS Outposts is also represented in the on-premises environment for hybrid cloud deployment scenarios.

graph.notes: Veritas InfoScale provides clustered global file system management across on-premises, AWS Outposts, and multi-region AWS environments (Region 1 and Region 2), automating storage tiering between EBS and S3.
